rows.text: Traceability — the footer names the exact command, template version, and SHA-256 of both inputs
Composability — the page is assembled from typed cards (conf, intel, questions, next, html) declared in JSON
Interoperability — the params contract is open JSON; anything that writes it can produce a brief
Atomic design — cards reuse the canonical template's atoms unchanged; the generator adds zero new CSS

recoil.title: Recoil — Why This Exists
recoil.text: The first draft of this idea was to stamp artifacts with a CLI that didn't exist. That is provenance theater: the first technical viewer who runs the command turns a transparency claim into a credibility hole. ADR-032 chose the inversion — build the smallest real generator first, then the stamp is free and honest.

rows.val: Generator built, template markers reused unchanged, proof artifact rendered end-to-end
All 13 live briefs had diverged from the template; forward-only adoption was the honest scope
